summary: Since ansible-core 2.12, each release supports the three most recently released Python versions on the control node.
questions: Which Python versions can I use on the Ansible control node?
How many Python versions does ansible-core support on the controller?

answer_card.title: Control node Python support policy
answer_card.answer_md: Starting with ansible-core 2.12, each release supports the **three most recently released** Python versions on the control node.
